text:
elaine: Quick check — running a 2x AB test next week for the new pricing path (pack-page -> guided flow). Need sign-off on microcopy variants and event names. Key ask: which CTA variant and what signals to route to sales. Draft figs + metric plan: https://tiny.redwood/pack-path. @mike @sara please. :eyes:

mike: +1. Leaning toward 'Start with Redwood' vs 'Try Redwood' — the former nudges commit intent. For routing: track GA event 'pricing_cta_click' + dimension 'intent_level' (low/med/high). Add server-side flag so we can map high-intent to SFDC lead flow. :dart:

sara: Agree w/ 'Start with Redwood'. FAQ note: collapse answers to 1-liners and add a single "learn more" modal for details. Also propose a small tooltip for the Dedicated vs Private line — we get repeated support tickets there. Small copy suggestion: "Dedicated: reserved capacity for predictable throughput" (1-liner).

ashok: Heatmap looked noisy — users drop after the slab explanation. Suggest moving the commitment badge above the slab and add microcopy: 'predictable monthly invoice' under the badge. Also increase prominence of the calculator results (bigger numbers + contrast). Will try one layout tweak and re-run heatmap.

jordan: Analytics mapping snippet to align events:```js
// dataLayer push example
window.dataLayer.push({
  event: 'pricing_cta_click',
  variant: 'cta_A',
  intent: 'high',
  source: 'pricing_landing'
});
window.dataLayer.push({event: 'slab_view'});
window.dataLayer.push({event: 'calculator_submit', value: 1});
```Recommend forwarding 'pricing_cta_click' + intent to Segment and SFDC as Lead.Source = 'pricing_experiment'. I'll open the PR and add GTM tag.

elaine: Nice. Owners: mike (CTA copy + variant assets), sara (FAQ modal + tooltip), ashok (layout tweak + heatmap rerun), jordan (analytics mapping + GTM). Can we canary Tue morning and watch conversion / demo-request rate? I'll wire up a 24h micro-survey for routed leads. :calendar:

mike: I'll have CTA assets in Figma and export-ready by Mon noon. Link when ready. :computer:

sara: Draft modal copy now, will post PR by EOD today. Keeping answers 1 line + link to full doc.

ashok: Reflow CSS to bump badge up; testing on staging Mon AM. If perf impact, fallback to smaller badge.

jordan: Mapping PR in analytics repo in ~2hrs, then GTM deploy to staging. Will also add the event naming doc in our shared drive.

elaine: Thanks team — I'll create LaunchDarkly rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and schedule the micro-survey in Intercom for routed leads. Will sync with sales on the intent thresholds. :sparkles:
